combo.description: Start your engage on multiple targets by instantly using W R, after the stun lands line up your E then quickly Q AA.
To take the opposition by complete surprise W R instantly, then while still in stealth E F Q AA as quickly as you can. Continue to AA after your R finishes.
Land a long range engage by using E then Flash mid animation, followed by instantly using Q R, then AA W right after you land.
To start a teamfight from outside your typical engage range R then Flash right before you go up in the air to stun, upon landing instantly Q E AA and W afterwards.
When you are at least level 6 E Q then W R instantly. Follow up with an AA after your R finishes.
To use your standard trade W forward then instantly AA E Q followed by a couple of AAs.
For a long trade AA then instantly Q followed by AA E AA. Use W to land your final AA.
For a quick burst of damage E Q instantly then quickly AA.
